title: You Don't Know Jack 2015
description: The smart-ass trivia show that started it all! Hundreds of all-new twisted trivia questions and everyone’s favorite host, Cookie Masterson!

title: Drawful
description: The drawing game that takes all other drawing games and draws little mustaches on them. Can’t draw? No problem! It’s funnier that way!

title: Word Spud
description: Keep the words rolling all night! Just finish the word coming toward you, like “Mail___.” Mail enhancement, you say? You nailed it.

title: Lie Swatter
description: Do lobsters pee out of their heads? Did Japan vote the instant noodle the top invention of the 20th century? Or are you calling BS?

title: Fibbage XL
description: Fool your friends with your lies, avoid theirs, and find the (usually outrageous) truth. “The mayor of Rabbit Hash, Kentucky is a ____.” Go!

title: Fibbage 2
description: More Fibbage! Lie to your friends, avoid their lies, and spot the truth. “In Arizona, you must obtain a permit to feed ______ to pigs.” Go!

title: Earwax
description: Cow moo? Huge explosion? Or tiny fart? Which to choose? It's the sound effects game that will leave you up to your ears in laughter!

title: Bidiots
description: Outbid your opponents for absurd art – drawn by players themselves – and win this strangely competitive auction game! Don’t be a bidiot!

title: Bomb Corp
description: Welcome to Bomb Corp. Interns of your kind must help defuse bombs in our office. It’s a weird office full of bombs. Just hit start.

title: Quiplash
description: Unknown

title: Fakin' It
description: Everyone gives an answer, but not everyone knows the question. One of your friends has something to hide. Find the faker before it’s too late!

title: Tee K.O.
description: Draw pictures, write slogans, then swap them around to create your own custom t-shirt warriors. Only the most worthy novelty t-shirt will leave the tournament alive.

title: Quiplash 2
description: The say-anything party game returns. Come up with "a bad substitute for dental floss" and win! Tired of our weird prompts? Try the new Make Your Own mode!

title: Trivia Murder Party
description: Be the last to survive a serial killer's absurd trivia game show. But it's fun!

title: Guesspionage
description: What percentage of people have buried something in the woods? Ridden in the back of a cop car? Have a crush on someone they work with? Guess right and win!

title: Fibbage 3
description: Fib your way through all-new question types and the all-newer game mode Fibbage: Enough About You. Guess the weird facts about your fellow players!

title: Survive the Internet
description: Log on and strap in! It’s survival of the funniest as you playfully take your friends out of context across the World Wide Web.

title: Monster Seeking Monster
description: A dating-themed game where you send funny messages and try to hide your secret monster powers. Just like real dating!

title: Bracketeering
description: The deranged debate tournament! “What’s the best vegetable for Benedict Cumberbatch to voice in a movie?” Place smart bets on what will win stupid arguments.

title: Civic Doodle
description: You’ve been hired to create murals all over Doodle Valley. Compete to see who can make the best additions in your attempt to “beautify” the city.

title: You Don't Know Jack: Full Stream
description: YOU DON’T KNOW JACK: Full Stream brings the classic irreverent trivia phenomenon to the wildly popular and totally fictional streaming service Binjpipe! Their terms of service explicitly states you’ll love it!

title: Split the Room
description: The what-if game where anything is possible! Create strange and divisive hypothetical situations.

title: Mad Verse City
description: The robot rap battle game! Spit mad rhymes against your friends to see who’s the dopest MC and who’s the wackest cat.

title: Zeeple Dome
description: The galaxy’s deadliest game show! Fling yourself and win fabulous prizes!!!

title: Patently Stupid
description: The inventive drawing game where you solve bizarre problems! Pitch your ideas to rake in the cash!

title: Trivia Murder Party 2
description: A serial killer is running an absurd trivia game out of the family-run Murder Hotel he grew up in. Can you survive?

title: Role Models
description: Everybody’s somebody, so who are you? The planner? The flake? The sassy one? Step into the lab and find out.

title: Joke Boat
description: Ahoy! You’re an amateur comic on a fourth-rate cruise ship. Do you have what it takes to win the talent show?

title: Dictionarium
description: Humans have been inventing words and phrases for centuries. Now it’s your turn to contribute an entry to the pages of the Dictionarium.

title: Push the Button
description: Danger! Shapeshifting aliens have infiltrated your starship. Can you and your crew find them before time runs out?

title: Talking Points
description: Give a speech about pictures you haven't seen before. It doesn’t matter if it makes sense, it’s more fun if it doesn’t!

title: Quiplash 3
description: The Threequel to the say-anything party game! Answer the prompts and make your friends laugh… hopefully.

title: The Devils and the Details
description: You're a family of devils who've moved to an average suburb. Can you survive the daily torture of human life?

title: Champ'd Up
description: Enter the Scrawliseum, where characters fight over weird titles. Can you take down the heavy favorite?

title: Blather 'Round
description: A pop culture guessing game where nothing sounds quite right! It's a good fun time experience.

title: Job Job
description: A comedy game where your jokes must be built of words from other players in a mixed up take on a job interview.

title: Drawful Animate
description: The third game in the Drawful series allows players to create two corresponding images which leads to one dynamic pictorial guessing game.

title: The Wheel of Enormous Proportions
description: General knowledge and random chance combine to create a trivia game where everybody has a chance to learn the ultimate answer.

title: The Poll Mine
description: A survey game that's all about YOU! Split into teams and see who can escape from the witch's lair!

title: Weapons Drawn
description: This social-deduction game turns a fancy ball into a killer free-for-all where you are both artistic murderer and attentive detective.

title: Fibbage 4
description: The hilarious bluffing party game returns with an all new Final Fibbage, video questions, fan-submitted questions, and Fibbage Enough About You mode!

title: Roomerang
description: Channel your inner reality TV star in an attempt to come out on top! Respond to prompts, bring the competition and role-play to avoid being voted out. Never fear though, even when you’re out you’ll find yourself Roomerang-ed right back into the drama!

title: Junktopia
description: A strange wizard has turned you into a frog! Create hilarious backstories for weird objects and then get them appraised. The player with the most valuable items becomes human again!

title: Nonsensory
description: Professor Nanners is here to test your NSP (Nonsensory Perception) in this drawing, writing, and guessing game! How close can you get to guessing where another player’s prompt ranks on the silliest of scales?

title: Quixort
description: In this trivia sorting factory, work with your team to sort falling answers into their proper order before they hit the floor! Or, play the single player mode and see how many blocks you can sort before topping out. It’s as easy as A, C, B!

title: Tee K.O. 2
description: In Tee K.O. 2, return to T-Shirt Island, where the most hardened warriors in the world compete in a deadly fighting tournament. The drawing finger–not the fist–decides the victory!

title: Dodo Re Mi
description: In Dodo Re Mi, your phone is your instrument. You and your flock must make music together to escape the hungry jungle plant.

title: FixyText
description: FixyText is the Wild West of text-editing. In this chaotic game, everyone’s in group chat, typing all at once to make the most memorable statement. And there’s no delete key. Take that auto-correct!

title: Timejinx
description: In Timejinx, you’re a time traveler from the future competing in a high-stakes trivia night. Save your current timeline by answering questions about the past.

title: Hypnotorious
description: Hypnotorious is a game with secret roles, tentative alliances and of course, silly answers to ridiculous questions. Who is on your side?

title: Tee K.O.
description: Draw pictures, write slogans, then swap them around to create your own custom t-shirt warriors. Only the most worthy novelty t-shirt will leave the tournament alive.

title: Trivia Murder Party 2
description: A serial killer is running an absurd trivia game out of the family-run Murder Hotel he grew up in. Can you survive?

title: Quiplash 3
description: The Threequel to the say-anything party game! Answer the prompts and make your friends laugh… hopefully.

title: Fakin' It All Night Long
description: Fakin’ It returns and this time we’re putting it all out there. Everyone gets a secret task except the Faker, who tries to blend in. Find out which of your friends is the best liar… and SO much more! Featuring new categories like “Finger Blast” and a brand new “remote play” mode. Who doesn’t like a good Finger Blast with their friends?

title: Dirty Drawful
description: It’s Drawful, but dirty… It's Dirty Drawful. Hosted by the one and only Drawful Owl, as you’ve never seen her before. We’ve taken the game that you love and added prompts to ensure your drawings are both terrible and titillating. This game has everything:, sex, drugs, and other things that we absolutely cannot list here! Also, if you can’t commit to a relationship, or a drawing, we added an undo button just for you.

title: Let Me Finish
description: Let Me Finish is Jackbox’s new presentation game that examines life’s serious questions like, “Where is the mailbox’s butt?” or “How does this avocado get aroused?” Everyone gets a chance to speak their mind, but will others pick up what you’re putting down?

title: Doominate
description: Take a perfectly lovely situation and destroy it in this head-to-head joke game where it feels so good to be so bad.

title: Legends of Trivia
description: Assemble your team and put your trivia knowledge to the test in a fantastical world full of danger! Teamwork! Monsters! Do you dare take on one of the most challenging trivia games yet?

title: Hear Say
description: Record sound effects and dialogue directly from your phone in a foley-inspired game where laughter is the soundtrack. Then, watch your voices come to life in a series of short movie clips!

title: Cookie Haus
description: Play the coziest and kookiest drawing game yet by fulfilling cookie design orders for unusual clientele. Don’t play on an empty stomach!

title: Suspectives
description: There’s been a crime, one player secretly did it, and the evidence comes from your own survey answers! Study the clues, defend your innocence (even if you’re lying), and put your friends on trial.
